sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 6346 of 2023
Applicant :- Sanjay Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lucknow

Counsel for Applicant :- Sandeep Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Sandeep Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Manish Kumar Pandey, learned Addl. Government Advocate-I, and perused the record.
2. By means of the instant application the applicant Sanjay Kumar S/o Vijay Kumar seeks bail in Case Crime No. 55 of 2023, under sections 376, I.P.C., P.S. Fakharpur, District Bahraich.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a First Information Report (F.I.R.) lodged on 24.02.2023 stating that when the informant's daughter had gone to ease herself on 19.02.2023 alongwith the informant's niece, the applicant had molested her.
4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail-application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent.

He has been falsely implicated in the present case for the reason of a dispute amongst children of the parties, regarding which a complaint was given by the applicant and the applicant was detained by the police under section 151, Cr.P.C. and both the parties were challaned under Sanjay Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...

5.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that there is no mention of the alleged incident in the report submitted by the investigating officer.
6. The victim was taken for medico-legal examination, but she declined to undergo the same.

7. A supplementary affidavit has been filed on behalf of the applicant disclosing his involvement in another case bearing Case Crime No. 106 of 2022 under sections 323, 504, 506, I.P.C., P.S.
Fakharpur, District Bahraich, in which his bail-application is pending.
8. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail-application, but could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the facts that the incident is alleged to have taken place on 19.02.2023, and the F.I.R. has been lodged on 24.02.2023 and there is no explanation for the delay; that in the report submitted by the Police station regarding challan of the parties under sections 151, 107 and 116, Cr.P.C. there is no mention of the incident and that the victim's medico-legal examination was declined, without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
10. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

11. Let the applicant Sanjay Kumar S/o Vijay Kumar be released on bail in the aforesaid Case Crime No. 55 of 20223, under sections 376, I.P.C., P.S. Fakharpur, District Bahraich, on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
12. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
(Subhash Vidyarthi, J.) Order Date :- 18.5.2023 A.Nigam  Sanjay Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192309789/
